name: devops-opnsense
description: Use when operating an OPNsense firewall/router - interfaces, VLANs and bridges, firewall rules and NAT, DNS (Unbound) and DHCP (Dnsmasq, Kea), WireGuard/OpenVPN/IPsec, multi-WAN gateway groups, high availability (CARP, pfsync, config sync), reverse proxy and IDS plugins, firmware updates, major upgrades, snapshots and rollback, config.xml backup and restore, the REST API and automation (Ansible, OpenTofu), running OPNsense as a VM, and troubleshooting. Not for Linux host nftables or generic networking (devops-networking), Proxmox itself (devops-proxmox), or security audit (fuse-security:security-expert).

findings.excerpt: pfctl -s nat                                   # NAT/reflection rules (read-only, on the firewall)
